title: PREPARATION
location: L02 · FAMILY HOME → L03 · DINING → L01 · BEDROOM
tod: 19:40 → 22:15 · evening, tungsten + one window of blue dusk
logline: The last ordinary night. A signature on a form, a mother packing a bag, a sister hiding a jacket, a brother sneaking a toy in.
grade: Warm tungsten interior fighting a cold blue window. Half the frame warm, half cold — the episode's last 'safety' image.

narration.hi: पापा ने फ़ॉर्म देखा, दो सवाल पूछे, और साइन कर दिए। माँ ने बैग पैक किया — जैसे मैं किसी युद्ध पर जा रहा हूँ।
narration.en: Papa looked at the form, asked two questions, and signed it. Maa packed my bag — as if I were going to war.

narration.hi: आरोही ने मेरी जैकेट छुपा दी थी, मज़ाक में। और विवान ने बैग में अपना खिलौना रख दिया — 'ताकि तुम अकेले न हो'।
narration.en: Aarohi had hidden my jacket, as a joke. And Vivaan put his toy in my bag — 'so you're not alone'.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, across the dining table from Pita's side
shots.move: Static; a single lamp pools light on the form.
shots.action: Ishaan sets the permission form down. Pita reads it, turns it over, reads the back, and looks up with two silent questions.
shots.expr: Pita: scrutiny without hostility. Ishaan: hopeful, trying to look responsible.
shots.env: Dining table at night: form, a pen, a cup of tea, the newspaper folded.
shots.light: Single tungsten pendant overhead creating a hard pool of light, the rest of the room in blue window light.
shots.cont: FORM LOCK: one A4 sheet, white, school letterhead at the top, a signature line at the bottom right. No readable text needed — but the same sheet must appear in S09-02.

shots.cam: Table height, 20 cm, macro on the signature line
shots.move: Static. He signs; the pen lifts; the shot holds on the wet ink.
shots.action: A fountain pen comes down and signs in one unhurried stroke. A thumb presses the corner flat.
shots.env: Paper fibres, pen nib, one drop of ink where the nib rested.
shots.light: Warm pool, raking low; the paper texture is the subject.
shots.cont: This is the last 'ordinary object' close-up before the observatory. Treat it as an heirloom shot.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.15 m, low, at the bed, Maa seated on its edge
shots.move: Static; gentle 8° arc as she leans to fold.
shots.action: She folds clothes with a precision that suggests she has done it a thousand times, counts them silently, and adds one extra sweater.
shots.expr: Absorbed. A mother's face doing arithmetic on the weather.
shots.env: Bedroom, open backpack on the bed, clothes stacked in neat thirds, a small torch, a strip of tablets.
shots.light: Warm bedside lamp from the left; window dusk behind her — rim light on her hair.
shots.vo: Line 1 ends on the extra sweater.
shots.cont: The bag is P-03; the same bag Ishaan carries in S04-06 and S10.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.35 m, in the bedroom doorway, Aarohi facing camera
shots.move: Static; she takes one step back when Ishaan reaches for her.
shots.action: Aarohi stands with the black jacket held behind her back and her chin high. Ishaan extends a hand. She shakes her head. One beat of standoff.
shots.expr: Nose in the air; the beginning of a grin she is fighting.
shots.light: Warm from the room, cool from the corridor — she's on the boundary line.
shots.cont: The jacket must remain visibly JKT-BLR-01 in her hands: crimson lining peeking out from her fingers.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.05 m, LOW at the bed, so the bag is at frame-centre
shots.move: Static. We see the act as a shadow, not an action.
shots.action: Vivaan, in the background, quietly pushes a small toy car into the bag's front pocket and steps away with his hands behind his back.
shots.expr: Guilty concentration; then a virtuously blank face.
shots.env: Bag front pocket, toy car: red, chipped paint (P-04).
shots.light: Warm lamp, with Vivaan half in shadow.
shots.cont: P-04 must be in frame on the observatory trip: it is visible again in S12-01 when the bag is opened. Prop continuity is the joke.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.60 m, from the corridor looking into the bedroom door
shots.move: Static, held. He crosses to the bag and closes it. Last 12 frames are the window.
shots.action: He zips the bag, sets it by the door, sits on the bed, and looks at his own bedroom for a moment.
shots.expr: Content, uncomplicated, entirely unaware. The last happy frame in the episode.
shots.env: Bedroom at night, lamp on, window showing deep blue dusk, bag by the door.
shots.light: Warm interior + blue window; the split at 50/50 is exactly the point.
shots.vo: Silence. Hold the final 3 s on the empty doorway after he lies back.
shots.cont: Final warm-to-cool hand-off in the episode: from here, the film's palette moves permanently toward blue.
